Hari Kotian has served 1000+ clients and recovered INR 50+ Crores in insurance claims. The platform specializes in claim rejection appeals, LIC policy assistance, IRDAI compliance, and tax-optimized insurance planning for Indian consumers.

## Health Insurance Claim Rejection: 15 Real Reasons + How to Prevent & Appeal Each One (2026)
URL: https://insurancesupport.online/blog/health-insurance-claim-rejection-15-real-reasons-how-to-prevent-appeal-each-one-2026

Health insurance claims in India face high rejection rates, with cashless claims having more issues than reimbursement claims. The 15 main reasons for rejection include: (1) Pre-existing disease (PED) waiting period violations - most policies have 2-4 year waiting periods; (2) Initial 30-day waiting period exclusions; (3) Specific disease waiting periods for cataracts, hernia, kidney stones, joint replacements; (4) Non-disclosure of medical conditions at proposal time; (5) Cosmetic and elective surgery exclusions; (6) Less than 24-hour hospitalization not meeting minimum threshold; (7) Non-network hospital treatment without prior authorization; (8) Missing original bills, prescriptions, diagnostic reports; (9) Non-medical expenses bundled into bills (attendant charges, food, toiletries); (10) Diagnosis-procedure mismatch in discharge summary; (11) Policy lapse due to missed renewal; (12) Room rent sub-limits exceeded; (13) Ambulance charges beyond policy limits; (14) Experimental treatment exclusions; (15) Documentation errors at hospital level.
## How to Appeal a Rejected Insurance Claim in India: Complete 2026 Guide
URL: https://insurancesupport.online/blog/how-to-appeal-rejected-insurance-claim-india-2026

Getting your insurance claim rejected is one of the most frustrating experiences for any policyholder. You paid premiums for years, and when you need the money the most, the insurer says no. But here is the truth: most rejected claims can be overturned. IRDAI data shows that 15-20% of claims are initially rejected, but a significant percentage of those are approved on appeal. This guide gives you the exact step-by-step process to fight back and get your claim paid. Before you appeal, understand the common reasons for rejection: Under IRDAI regulations, insurers must provide a written rejection letter explaining the specific reason for rejection, the policy clause under which it was rejected, and the documents they reviewed. Do not accept verbal rejections. If they refuse to give written reasons, escalate immediately to IRDAI.
## IRDAI Claim Settlement Regulations 2026: 30-Day Rule & Standardized Forms
URL: https://insurancesupport.online/blog/irdai-claim-settlement-regulations-2026-30-day-rule-standardized-forms

Every year, thousands of Indian policyholders face the same frustrating situation: they filed their insurance claim complete with all required documents, but weeks pass with no word from the insurer. The claim sits in limbo, the family is anxious, and the insurer offers no timeline. If this sounds familiar, you need to know about the IRDAI claim settlement regulations that exist specifically to protect you. The Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority of India (IRDAI) has laid down clear, binding rules about how fast insurers must settle claims, what forms they must use, and what happens if they fail. In this comprehensive 2026 guide, we explain every aspect of IRDAI claim settlement regulations — so you know exactly what your rights are and how to enforce them. The IRDAI claim settlement framework is built on the **Protection of Policyholders Interest Regulations, 2017** (amended through 2024-25) and various circulars issued by the regulator.
## LIC Policy Revival Complete Guide 2026
URL: https://insurancesupport.online/blog/lic-policy-revival-complete-guide-2026

Reviving a lapsed LIC policy is easier than most policyholders think. If your LIC policy has lapsed due to non-payment of premiums, you can typically revive it within 5 years of the lapse period without undergoing a fresh medical examination in most cases. When you stop paying premiums on your LIC policy, it enters a "lapsed" status after the grace period (usually 30 days for annual premiums, 15 days for half-yearly/quarterly). During the lapse period: You can revive a lapsed LIC policy within **5 consecutive years** from the date of first unpaid premium. After 5 years, the policy cannot be revived and you lose all benefits. Visit the LIC website (licindia.in) or use the LIC mobile app to check your policy status. You can also call LIC customer care at 022-6789 7777.
## LIC Policy Claim Rejected: How to Appeal and Win
URL: https://insurancesupport.online/blog/lic-policy-claim-rejected-how-to-appeal-and-win

A claim rejection is not the end of the road. Most policyholders give up after the first rejection letter, but the law provides multiple layers of protection for you. Whether it is a life insurance death claim or a health insurance reimbursement, here is your roadmap to fighting back. Common reasons include non-disclosure of pre-existing diseases, technical errors in the form, or policy exclusions. LIC and other insurers must provide a specific reason for rejection in writing. Do not accept a verbal rejection. You need the formal letter stating the exact clause under which the claim was denied. This is your primary evidence for an appeal. Every insurer has a Grievance Redressal Officer. Write a formal letter explaining why the rejection is unfair. Attach supporting medical records or evidence that contradicts the insurer's reason. If the insurer doesn't respond within 30 days or rejects your internal appeal, the Ombudsman is your best friend.

## Motor Insurance in India 2026: Car and Two-Wheeler Insurance Complete Guide
URL: https://insurancesupport.online/blog/motor-insurance-in-india-2026-car-and-two-wheeler-insurance-complete-guide

Motor insurance is mandatory under the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988 in India. Every vehicle on Indian roads must have at minimum a third-party insurance policy. In 2026, with over 300 million registered vehicles and rising road accidents, understanding motor insurance is essential for every vehicle owner. IDV (Insured Declared Value) is the maximum compensation your insurer will pay if your vehicle is stolen or totally damaged. It is essentially the current market value of your vehicle after depreciation. Formula: IDV = Manufacturer's Listed Price - Depreciation A higher IDV means higher premium but better compensation. Never understate your IDV to save on premium - it will result in lower compensation at claim time. Learn more: https://insurancesupport.online/resources/faq/what-is-idv-in-car-insurance NCB is a discount on your own damage premium for every claim-free year: NCB is transferable if you change insurer or vehicle.

## Section 80C Insurance Premium Deduction 2026: Save Tax on Life Insurance
URL: https://insurancesupport.online/blog/section-80c-insurance-premium-deduction-2026-save-tax-life-insurance

Every year, millions of Indians scramble to save tax in the last quarter — and overlook the most powerful tool they already own: life insurance. Section 80C of the Income Tax Act allows you to deduct up to ₹1.5 lakh per financial year from your taxable income. And life insurance premiums are one of the most attractive investments that qualify — because they offer dual benefits of **tax savings** AND **financial protection** for your family. But here is the catch: not all insurance policies qualify equally, there are hidden caps most people miss, and choosing the wrong approach can cost you both tax benefits and adequate coverage. In this complete 2026 guide, we break down exactly how to use Section 80C with life insurance to minimize your tax bill while maximizing your family's financial security.
